lines.text: She shipped the payments revamp end to end. That is not a supporting role, that is ownership.
I agree on ownership. But listen to this: 'kind of handled the launch'. 'Kind of' is doing a lot of work in that sentence.
lines.quote: I kind of handled the launch

lines.text: Numbers are real — checkout failures down 30%. I just have one question: who is the user here?
Someone who says no to a six-month rewrite and ships the patch understands tradeoffs. I want that person on my team.
lines.quote: We said no to the full rewrite

lines.text: The tradeoff story is good. Still, a PM who never mentions a single customer makes me nervous.
Exactly. Zero users, zero merchants, zero customers. I cannot hire a PM on zero signal.
Ownership and impact carry her for me. Hire — but someone better ask her about users before the offer letter.

verdicts.product_lead: Hire: ownership and impact outweigh the user gap.
verdicts.eng_manager: Hire: ships real things and makes hard calls.
verdicts.founder: No hire: no users mentioned, and that is my red line.
